method_summary: Chabauty-Coleman p-adic integration at p=5 with Mordell-Weil sieving
problem_statement: Let C1: y^2 = x^5 - 2x^3 + x + 1 over Q (smooth, genus 2, one point at infinity). Naively visible points are infinity, (0,+/-1), (1,+/-1), (-1,+/-1). With Jacobian rank 1 and p=5 a good ordinary Chabauty prime, prove via an explicit annihilating differential, Coleman per-disk zero bound, and Mordell-Weil sieve at auxiliary primes 29 and 43 that C1(Q) equals exactly this finite set.
record_title: Closing one rank-1 quintic genus-2 curve via Coleman bound at p=5 and sieve at 29,43
recovery_conditions: state a substantive result not covered by the identified prior work; supply independent motivation and a materially stronger contribution; address the recorded limitation: Disproof of the exact 7-point census only; no determination of the full (larger) C1(Q), no rank or Chabauty/sieve claims.
